name: Nagymaros (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner: a blue upper part with a chief of the Hungarian arms and a rose, charged with a red-clad figure of Saint Martin on a white horse on a green mound, over a lower part of three vertical stripes of red, white and green with a blue hoist stripe.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagymaros arms — Saint Martin on horseback
